title: Translation of Life-Saving Knowledge – Animated Entertainment-Education Video to Increase Uptake of Screening Colonoscopy: Study Protocol for a Hybrid Type 1 Effectiveness-Implementation Study
summary: Colorectal cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths, even though colonoscopy is a safe screening method available. By increasing the participation rate in preventive colonoscopies, many cases of colorectal cancer could be prevented. We are conducting an online study to determine whether a short, animated, and entertaining informational video about screening colonoscopies motivates people to undergo a colonoscopy compared with receiving no information. The study includes 3,000 people residing in Germany who are 50 years of age or older and have not had a colonoscopy in the past 10 years. Participants will be randomly assigned to one of two groups: Group A will watch the animated video, and Group B will receive no information and will continue with the questionnaire after a short waiting page. All participants will complete the same short online questionnaire before and after the video or the waiting page. We compare the responses within the groups (before vs. after) as well as between the groups to determine whether the video improves knowledge about colorectal cancer and colonoscopy and makes people more likely to decide to undergo a colonoscopy. Participants in Group A who have watched the animated video will be asked at the end of the online questionnaire whether they would be willing to participate in an interview. These 30-minute interviews are designed to examine participants’ perceptions of the animated “edutainment” video and to identify potential factors that could influence the video’s future dissemination in the real-world settings

interventions.name: Completing the first part of the questionnaire (approx. 2 min), presentation of the animated “edutainment” video that provides information about colorectal cancer and the preventive benefits of colonoscopy (approx. 1 min), completing the second part of the questionnaire (approx. 2 min), optional reg
Completing the first part of the questionnaire (approx. 2 min), a waiting page without any information (10 seconds), completing the second part of the questionnaire (approx. 2 min).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
a. German-speaking and resident in Germany
b. Adult ≥ 50 years of age
c. No colonoscopy in the last 10 years 
d. No previous diagnosis of colorectal cancer
Exclusion criteria:
a. Not German-speaking
b. Not resident in Germany
c. Adults under 50 years of age
d. Colonoscopy within the past 10 years
